props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether an accordion item can be closed after it has been expanded.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the expanded accordion items.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the accordion.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the accordion items are disabled

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the accordion. Useful for composition.

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: The callback fired when the focused accordion item changes.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The callback fired when the state of expanded/collapsed accordion items changes.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the accordion items.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the expanded accordion items.
